course_name_original: Programación, Algoritmos y Estructuras de Datos

learning_outcomes.text: Apply modern concepts of algorithms and data structures in the development of computer programs for problem solving.

syllabus_topics: Analysis and Design of software applications.
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a minimum grade of 5 out of 10 is required for both the theoretical exam (EX) and assignments (TR). If these minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as: 0.30 * EX + 0.70 * TR. Otherwise, the final grade will be the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0. For the extraordinary call, the same evaluable elements and grades obtained during the course are maintained, but students may submit alternative assignments if requested. The same formula and minimum grade conditions apply for the final grade, otherwise, the grade will be the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0.
